entries.headline: Novavax publicly funded COVID-19 vaccine launched October 19; people aged 12+ can choose it
entries.why: Public programme (公費): Taiwan's protein-based Novavax XFG vaccine now sits alongside Moderna, and outlets ran eligibility explainers on launch day. This follows Taiwan CDC's October 13 notice, which also said more Novavax doses are planned.
entries.headline_zh: Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗10月19日開打，12歲以上民眾可選擇
entries.why_zh: 公費：台灣蛋白質次單位Novavax XFG疫苗現與Moderna並列可選，媒體於開打當天刊出接種資格說明。此前疾管署10月13日公告亦表示，規劃增購Novavax疫苗。

entries.headline: Public flu shots pass 3.24 million, up 9.5% year on year; COVID-19 passes 1.01 million
entries.why: Public programme (公費): many outlets carried CDC uptake figures and its estimate of the next wave's timing. The coverage frames the 左流右新 campaign as ahead of last season's pace.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗接種突破324萬劑，年增9.5%；COVID-19疫苗突破101萬劑
entries.why_zh: 公費：多家媒體報導疾管署接種數據及其對下一波疫情時間的預估，並將「左流右新」活動描述為進度領先上一季。

entries.headline: Report: CDC urgently adds 500,000 flu doses as demand rises 15%
entries.why: Likely the public programme: CDC said on October 13 it planned extra flu doses, and one outlet now reports 500,000, with Pingtung leading uptake. The growth figure differs from the 9.5% other outlets report, so supply-side questions may follow.
entries.headline_zh: 報導：需求增加15%，疾管署緊急追加50萬劑流感疫苗
entries.why_zh: 可能屬公費：疾管署10月13日表示規劃追加流感疫苗，現有一家媒體報導為50萬劑，並指屏東接種率領先。該成長數字與其他媒體報導的9.5%不同，後續可能引發供應面疑問。

entries.headline: Nantou's 17 flu and COVID-19 deaths, above national rates, prompt magistrate vaccination call
entries.why: Public programme (公費): Magistrate Hsu Shu-hua is using the county's death figures, mostly older adults, to push eligible residents to vaccinate. Nationally, CDC separately warned that election events raise cluster risk.
entries.headline_zh: 南投流感及COVID-19死亡17例、高於全國比率，縣長呼籲接種疫苗
entries.why_zh: 公費：縣長許淑華以縣內死亡數據（多為長者）呼籲符合資格的縣民接種。全國層面，疾管署另警告選舉活動提高群聚風險。

entries.headline: COVID-19 safety misinformation circulates on Threads: saline, stillbirth and DNA-integration claims
entries.why: Funding not stated: the posts target COVID-19 vaccines in general, and one names Moderna and Pfizer. The saline post drew the highest engagement, and a stillbirth claim attributed to a California nurse is repeated across posts.
entries.headline_zh: Threads流傳COVID-19疫苗安全性錯誤訊息：生理食鹽水、死產及DNA嵌入等說法
entries.why_zh: 未說明公費或自費：貼文泛指COVID-19疫苗，其中一則點名Moderna與Pfizer。生理食鹽水貼文互動最高，另有歸於一名加州護理師的死產說法在多則貼文中重複出現。

entries.headline: Cost posts: NT$16,000 infant RSV antibody, clinic registration fees, willingness to pay
entries.why: Both arenas: one post cites NT$16,000 per dose for an infant RSV antibody (likely 自費). Another user reports NT$150-200 registration fees for public flu shots (公費), and a third asks what people would pay for a self-paid flu shot.
entries.headline_zh: 費用貼文：嬰兒RSV抗體NT$16,000、診所掛號費、付費意願
entries.why_zh: 公費與自費皆有：一則貼文指嬰兒RSV抗體每劑NT$16,000（可能為自費）。另一用戶表示公費流感疫苗掛號費NT$150-200（公費），第三則詢問大家願意花多少錢自費打流感疫苗。

watch.text: Second stage of publicly funded flu vaccination opens; watch for supply and access stories as eligibility widens.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打；隨接種對象擴大，留意供應與可近性相關報導。

watch.text: Early Novavax uptake figures and arrival of the extra flu and Novavax doses CDC said it plans.
watch.text_zh: Novavax初期接種數據，以及疾管署規劃追加的流感與Novavax疫苗到貨情形。

watch.text: Whether the stillbirth or saline claims move from Threads into mainstream media during the election period.
watch.text_zh: 選舉期間，死產或生理食鹽水說法是否從Threads擴散至主流媒體。

qa.q: Is the public flu programme at risk of running short?
qa.a: No shortage is reported. CDC said on October 13 it plans additional flu doses, and one outlet reports 500,000 extra doses. Cumulative public flu shots have passed 3.24 million, up 9.5% year on year, per multiple outlets.
qa.q_zh: 公費流感疫苗是否有短缺風險？
qa.a_zh: 目前無短缺報導。疾管署10月13日表示規劃追加流感疫苗，一家媒體報導追加50萬劑。據多家媒體報導，公費流感疫苗累計接種已突破324萬劑，年增9.5%。

qa.q: How is the Novavax launch being covered?
qa.a: Neutrally. Launch-day pieces explain eligibility, and one says people aged 12+ can choose Novavax. No Novavax-specific social posts or misinformation appeared in the last 72 hours.
qa.a_zh: 中性。開打當天報導以說明接種資格為主，其中一則指12歲以上民眾可選擇Novavax。過去72小時未見針對Novavax的社群貼文或錯誤訊息。

qa.q: Is there any conversation on enhanced flu vaccines, RSV or Tdap?
qa.a: Little, and it is shrinking. Weekly volume fell for enhanced flu (23 vs 42), RSV (15 vs 30) and Tdap (0 vs 10). A physician piece on flu raising heart attack and stroke risk in over-65s mentions adjuvanted vaccines, and one post cites NT$16,000 per infant RSV antibody dose.
qa.q_zh: 加強型流感疫苗、RSV或Tdap是否有相關討論？
qa.a_zh: 很少，且持續減少。每週聲量下降：加強型流感（23對42）、RSV（15對30）、Tdap（0對10）。一篇醫師文章談流感提高65歲以上長者心肌梗塞與中風風險時提及佐劑疫苗，另有一則貼文指嬰兒RSV抗體每劑NT$16,000。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: This notice set the 2026-27 narrative that public flu and COVID-19 uptake is outpacing last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告定調2026-27年度敘事：公費流感與COVID-19疫苗接種進度超越去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: This notice added Novavax to the public COVID-19 programme from October 19, flagged planned extra flu and Novavax doses, and linked vaccination to health coins, so it shapes both supply and brand choice in the 公費 arena.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗計畫，提及規劃追加流感與Novavax疫苗，並將接種與健康幣連結，因此同時影響公費領域的供應與品牌選擇。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines are saline, fake or a placebo
misinfo.note: This is the highest-engagement post in the period; track spread and keep factual product-quality and regulatory-release information ready for health authorities if asked.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗是生理食鹽水、假疫苗或安慰劑
misinfo.note_zh: 此為期間內互動最高的貼文；追蹤擴散情形，並備妥產品品質與檢驗放行等事實資訊，供衛生主管機關詢問時使用。

misinfo.claim: Stillbirths rose at a California hospital after pregnant women were urged to get COVID-19 vaccines
misinfo.note: The claim is repeated across posts and attributed to a nurse; prepare pregnancy safety evidence for medical societies and authorities, and escalate if mainstream media pick it up.
misinfo.claim_zh: 加州一家醫院在呼籲孕婦接種COVID-19疫苗後死產增加
misinfo.note_zh: 此說法在多則貼文中重複出現，歸於一名護理師；為醫學會與主管機關準備孕期安全性證據，若主流媒體跟進則升級處理。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccine DNA integrates into human chromosomes and tumours (names Moderna/Pfizer)
misinfo.note: Engagement is low; track whether it is linked to the current Moderna rollout.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗DNA會嵌入人類染色體並引發腫瘤（點名Moderna/Pfizer）
misinfo.note_zh: 互動低；追蹤是否與目前Moderna接種連結。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines damage the spleen and immune system, cause hair loss; detox products advised
misinfo.note: These are low-engagement anecdotes; flag the detox-product angle to authorities if it grows.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗損害脾臟與免疫系統、導致掉髮；建議使用排毒產品
misinfo.note_zh: 屬低互動個人經驗；若排毒產品面向擴大，通報主管機關。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines killed 400 million people; vaccines contain parasites; no package inserts were provided
misinfo.note: These are fringe conspiracy posts with minimal engagement; no action beyond tracking.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗害死4億人；疫苗含寄生蟲；未提供仿單
misinfo.note_zh: 屬邊緣陰謀論貼文，互動極少；僅需追蹤。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Thin. One post from a pregnant user recommends an infant RSV monoclonal antibody, citing NT$16,000 per dose and a 32–36 week prenatal window. The post does not name a brand and appears to blend infant antibody and prenatal dosing. A second user reports postponing an RSV shot in favour of flu. RSV volume halved week on week (15 vs 30).
products.implication: Parent-to-parent posts are shaping price perceptions and may confuse infant antibody protection with maternal options. Conversation is too small to show a demand trend.
products.action: Prepare accurate, label-based reference material on infant RSV protection pathways for healthcare professionals and medical societies. Keep monitoring parent forums for price and timing confusion. Do not engage consumers directly.
products.signal_zh: 討論稀少。一名孕婦用戶貼文推薦嬰兒RSV單株抗體，指每劑NT$16,000及產前32–36週接種時段。貼文未提品牌，且似混淆嬰兒抗體與產前接種。另一用戶表示延後RSV接種改打流感疫苗。RSV聲量較前一週減半（15對30）。
products.implication_zh: 家長間的貼文正形塑價格認知，且可能混淆嬰兒抗體保護與孕婦接種選項。討論量太小，無法顯示需求趨勢。
products.action_zh: 為醫療人員與醫學會準備以仿單為依據的嬰兒RSV保護途徑正確參考資料。持續監測家長論壇的價格與時機混淆。不直接與消費者互動。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: No item this week names the high-dose vaccine, and mentions are down (hd 9 vs 13; enhanced 23 vs 42). Adjacent signals are physician coverage of flu-linked heart attack and stroke risk in over-65s and Nantou's 17 deaths, mostly older adults. CDC also plans additional flu doses, though the items do not say whether any are enhanced.
products.implication: Severity stories keep older-adult protection on the agenda while the enhanced programme itself has dropped out of the news. Questions may follow about how far enhanced doses have reached and whether top-ups include them.
products.action: Prepare an evidence pack on older-adult flu burden and real-world rollout in long-term care facilities for CDC and advisory stakeholders. Coordinate with long-term care operators and local health bureaus on rollout data. Avoid any brand comparison.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費提供長照機構65歲以上長者
products.signal_zh: 本週無任何內容提及高劑量疫苗，提及量下降（高劑量9對13；加強型23對42）。相關訊號為醫師談流感導致65歲以上長者心肌梗塞與中風風險的報導，及南投17例死亡（多為長者）。疾管署亦規劃追加流感疫苗，但未說明是否含加強型。
products.implication_zh: 嚴重度報導使長者保護持續受關注，但加強型疫苗計畫本身已淡出新聞。後續可能出現加強型疫苗涵蓋程度及追加採購是否包含加強型的疑問。
products.action_zh: 為疾管署與諮詢相關人士準備長者流感疾病負擔及長照機構實際接種情形的證據資料。與長照機構業者及地方衛生局協調接種數據。避免任何品牌比較。

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Nothing this week: Tdap mentions fell to zero (from 10 the previous week), and no news, social or official item addressed pertussis or Tdap.
products.implication: With the flu and COVID-19 campaign dominating attention, Tdap currently has no public visibility.
products.action: Keep baseline monitoring. Hold background material on adult and maternal pertussis protection ready for medical societies, should pertussis cases or maternal vaccination re-enter the news.
products.signal_zh: 本週無相關內容：Tdap提及量降至零（前一週為10），無任何新聞、社群或官方內容涉及百日咳或Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 流感與COVID-19疫苗接種活動吸引主要關注，Tdap目前無公眾能見度。
products.action_zh: 維持基本監測。備妥成人與孕婦百日咳保護背景資料供醫學會使用，以因應百日咳病例或孕婦接種重回新聞。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi; public programme from Oct 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added Novavax to the public programme from October 19 and plans additional Novavax doses. Several outlets ran neutral eligibility explainers, one noting that people aged 12 and over may choose it. Social posts repeat unverified COVID-19 vaccine claims, but none in the items names Novavax.
products.implication: Launch coverage is factual and eligibility-focused, so the first weeks of uptake and any early reports will set the narrative. Generic COVID-19 misinformation could attach to a newly visible product.
products.action: Work with distribution partners, local health bureaus and contracted clinics so eligibility and access information is consistent. Prepare factual, label-based Q&A for CDC and medical journalists. Set up monitoring for Novavax-specific adverse-event or availability posts.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，由Sanofi在台經銷；10月19日起納入公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費計畫，並規劃追加Novavax疫苗。多家媒體刊出中性的接種資格說明，其中一則指12歲以上可選擇。社群貼文重複未經證實的COVID-19疫苗說法，但均未點名Novavax。
products.implication_zh: 開打報導以事實與接種資格為主，因此最初幾週的接種情形與早期報導將定調敘事。泛COVID-19錯誤訊息可能附著於新曝光的產品。
products.action_zh: 與經銷夥伴、地方衛生局及合約院所合作，確保接種資格與可近性資訊一致。為疾管署及醫藥記者準備以仿單為依據的事實Q&A。建立針對Novavax不良事件或供應狀況貼文的監測。

issues.title: Second-stage public flu eligibility opens as CDC tops up flu and Novavax doses
issues.note: Wider eligibility on top of demand already up 9.5% may bring allocation and stock-out questions at clinics. The extra dose orders put supply partners in view.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感第二階段開放，疾管署追加流感與Novavax疫苗
issues.note_zh: 在需求已增加9.5%之上擴大接種對象，可能引發診所配送與缺貨疑問。追加採購使供應夥伴受到關注。

issues.title: Next-wave peak, election-season clusters and SV.2.4 variant questions
issues.note: CDC next-wave estimates, Nantou death coverage and a variant detected in August could prompt media questions on older-adult coverage and on strain match.
issues.title_zh: 下一波高峰、選舉期間群聚與SV.2.4變異株疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署下一波預估、南投死亡報導及8月檢出的變異株，可能引發媒體詢問長者接種涵蓋率及病毒株吻合度。

issues.title: COVID-19 misinformation spilling onto newly launched products
issues.note: High-engagement Threads claims (saline, stillbirths in pregnancy) are generic for now. Prepare for brand-specific variants as the Novavax rollout gains visibility.
issues.title_zh: COVID-19錯誤訊息延燒至新上市產品
issues.note_zh: Threads高互動說法（生理食鹽水、孕期死產）目前屬泛指。隨Novavax接種能見度提高，需預備出現針對品牌的版本。

self_pay.title: Clinic fees on public flu shots
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports registration fees of NT$150–200 for a publicly funded flu shot and asks which clinic is cheapest. These are out-of-pocket costs within the public arena, not self-pay vaccine sales.
self_pay.title_zh: 公費流感疫苗的診所費用
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄用戶表示公費流感疫苗掛號費NT$150–200，並詢問哪家診所最便宜。此為公費領域內的自付費用，非自費疫苗銷售。

self_pay.title: Willingness to pay for a flu shot
self_pay.note: One post asks how much people would pay to get a flu shot themselves. It is a faint signal of private demand from people outside eligible groups, with no prices or clinics named.
self_pay.note_zh: 一則貼文詢問大家願意花多少錢自費打流感疫苗。此為非公費對象自費需求的微弱訊號，未提及價格或診所。

self_pay.title: Infant RSV antibody price talk
self_pay.note: A pregnant user cites NT$16,000 per dose for an infant RSV monoclonal antibody, suggesting price awareness spreads parent to parent. The post does not say where it is stocked.
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦用戶指嬰兒RSV單株抗體每劑NT$16,000，顯示價格認知在家長間傳播。貼文未說明何處有貨。

self_pay.title: No signal on enhanced flu or Tdap self-pay stock
self_pay.note: Nothing this week addresses self-pay availability, stock or pricing of adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines or Tdap at clinics.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感或Tdap自費供貨無相關訊號
self_pay.note_zh: 本週無內容涉及診所佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗或Tdap的自費供應、庫存或價格。
